debug.title: Debug container in {pod}
debug.imageStrict: Only images allowed by the administrator can be used.

profiles.general: General: adds SYS_PTRACE, so you can trace processes
profiles.restricted: Restricted: non-root, no capabilities (for Pod Security "restricted")

debug.note: The container stays in the pod spec until the pod is deleted and cannot be removed. It exits when you close the terminal.
